unit_of_analysis: One distinct named legal, policy or programme instrument, in the captured edition. Different hosts, translations, application forms, duplicate copies, amendments incorporated within a captured compilation, and index pages are not extra units.
measurement: Single nominal category; exactly one of the listed codes for each codable instrument. It measures the instrument's direct principal mechanism, not its desired social outcome, legal force, policy effectiveness or market impact.

categories.name: Institutional framework and scope
categories.definition: Creates a regulatory authority, assigns its broad powers/jurisdiction, or supplies a standalone cross-cutting definitions/scope instrument without a more specific operative mechanism.
categories.exclude: Do not classify every regulation here merely because it cites an enabling Act or defines terms.

categories.name: Product or business authorisation
categories.definition: Makes prior case-specific approval, registration or a premises/business licence the central gate to manufacture, import, market or operate.
categories.exclude: Claim/logo endorsement alone is INFORMATION; biosafety-risk regimes are SAFETY; border clearance as a whole is TRADE.

categories.name: Product information and claims
categories.definition: Controls labels, nutritional/allergen declarations, consumer-facing claims, identity communication or claim-specific logos and their integrity.
categories.exclude: A general food-product registration instrument with an incidental logo remains AUTHORISATION.

categories.name: Safety, biosafety and enforcement
categories.definition: Directly controls hazards, containment, hygiene, inspection, sampling, recall, corrective action or risk management, including biotechnology biosafety.
categories.exclude: A founding authority Act is FRAMEWORK; a generic product-approval procedure is AUTHORISATION.

categories.name: Border and trade procedures
categories.definition: Primarily establishes food import/export clearance, border inspection, consignment controls or cross-border procedures.
categories.exclude: A broad authority Act mentioning trade remains FRAMEWORK; a generic product approval that also covers imports remains AUTHORISATION.

categories.name: Research and innovation support
categories.definition: Provides a strategy, programme, infrastructure, funding call or eligibility mechanism for research, translation, scale-up or technical capability.
categories.exclude: A funding policy or call is not a food-safety marketing authorisation or evidence of an actual grant.

categories.name: Product composition standards
categories.definition: Primarily specifies product-specific identity, permitted ingredients, compositional/nutrient limits or measured product quality standards.
categories.exclude: General definitions without product thresholds are FRAMEWORK; communicating composition on a label is INFORMATION.

categories.name: Halal assurance procedures
categories.definition: Primarily specifies operational halal certification, process assurance, traceability or certification-body assessment requirements.
categories.exclude: An Act establishing a halal authority and broad powers is FRAMEWORK; this code never constitutes a religious ruling on a product.

decision_rules: Read the original title/preamble, scope and first substantive operative chapter plus the cited mechanism. Record a source locator and short rationale. Never code solely from an index label.

For a broad Act whose central action is establishing an authority and assigning powers, choose FRAMEWORK. Specific offences or trade/halal provisions inside that Act do not change the instrument-level code.

An instrument that only establishes general definitions/scope, with no more specific substantive mechanism in the captured text, is FRAMEWORK. Do not invent a registration mechanism from a Food Product title.

For a specialised instrument, use its direct operative mechanism: funding/support -> INNOVATION; biosafety/hazard/inspection/recall -> SAFETY; border clearance -> TRADE; generic product/premises entry gate -> AUTHORISATION; claims/labels/logo integrity -> INFORMATION; product composition thresholds -> COMPOSITION; operational halal certification -> HALAL.

Claim-specific vegan/halal logo endorsement remains INFORMATION when its direct object is the claim or consumer-facing identity. An instrument requiring registration of the food product itself remains AUTHORISATION even if a logo is also required.

If two mechanisms genuinely remain co-primary, first use the explicit purpose/short title, then the first dedicated substantive chapter after definitions. Prefer this written tie-break over counting pages or selecting the code that seems favourable.

If the captured text is too incomplete, unreadable or ambiguous to apply these rules, leave primary_function null and set coding_status='uncodable' with the reason. Do not force a label. A missing notification day alone does not prevent coding a visible mechanism.

Existing title years, assent dates, notification dates, printed Gazette dates, commencement conditions and call deadlines are separate metadata. Coding primary_function does not verify current legal force.
independence_protocol: The source set is a purposive coverage/calibration sample of 20 instruments, not a random sample of all country policies. The taxonomy was developed with access to these source texts; do not call it a held-out reliability test.
Freeze this codebook and the 20 IDs/source hashes first. Save agent codes in a separate frozen file and record its SHA-256 without exposing its answers in the author form.
The author receives this codebook, neutral instrument titles, source URLs and locators, and records 20 independent primary_function values and rationales before opening or discussing agent answers.
No author values may be filled by an agent. Blank author values remain blank. Disclosure of agent answers before completion is a protocol deviation and prevents claiming blind independent coding.

Retain the first-round author and agent files unchanged. Any discussion or recoding creates a new labelled round, with the original agreement result retained; do not repeatedly revise only disagreements to manufacture a passing threshold.

kappa_protocol.formula: kappa = (p_observed - p_expected) / (1 - p_expected); p_expected = sum over categories of (agent marginal proportion * author marginal proportion).
required_report: 20/20 independent complete paired labels for the requested acceptance criterion
confusion matrix across all prespecified categories
kappa with denominator n and the missing/uncodable count
any disclosure, codebook revision or recoding deviations
kappa_protocol.missing: Do not impute blank or uncodable labels and do not treat missingness as a substantive category. If fewer than 20 valid pairs, any partial kappa is exploratory and the 20-item criterion remains unmet.
kappa_protocol.undefined: If expected agreement equals 1, report kappa as undefined rather than substituting 1.
kappa_protocol.threshold: The brief requires kappa >= 0.7. No result or passing status exists until real independent author coding is supplied.
kappa_protocol.interpretation: Agreement is classification reliability on this selected set, not proof that policy interpretations, legal-effect claims or market effects are correct.

scope_limits: No market sizes, elasticities, projections or platform approval claims are produced by this exercise.
A programme call is distinct from its parent policy but not evidence of funding disbursement or food approval.
Primary-source accessibility and source identity are separate from comprehensive legal currency and scholarly approval.
